label: **⌘W closes the URL bar**
description: When the URL bar is focused or open, Cmd+W closes it instead of the tab behind it. Changes apply immediately.

label: **Toasts disappear after 5 seconds**
description: Corner toasts like “Link copied to clipboard” auto-hide after 5 seconds. Off = Zen's normal auto-hide (2 s).

label: **Better URL bar suggestions**
description: Autofill pages you visit often and show up to 15 suggestions in the dropdown. Off = Zen defaults.

label: **Pin the ⋯ menu into the corner**
description: Moves the ⋯ app menu flush into the top-right corner of the page area when it opens. Changes apply on the next time you open the menu.

label: **Remove the video picture-in-picture button**
description: Hides the PiP button that appears in the corner of videos on hover. Applies to videos opened afterwards; changes take effect immediately.

label: **Dock the ⋯ menu as a right sidebar**
description: Experimental: the ⋯ app menu opens as a resizable panel on the right side of the window instead of a popup, and the page area shrinks to fit. Drag the divider to resize. Off = normal popup. Turning it off undocks the menu immediately.
